doc.title: Urbie Green interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995

title: Recording with Basie in New York studios
summary: Added to Basie's three trombones on records, getting solos on about four albums, plus Ella Fitzgerald and Sammy Davis Jr. dates.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Did you ever have an occasion to play with Basie in any context?

Well, in the recording studios. He would come to New York to make records and he normally only carried three trombones with him so they’d add me on to the band to fill out the section, and I ended up getting a few solos down on the record with Basie. I think it was about four albums, and then Ella Fitzgerald came in and recorded with the Basie band so they added a trombone on that. And Sammy Davis Jr. Like the recording studios got me into a lot of different situations you know, a lot of people would come through New York and add me on to the band.
